# Slide count by talk length

Use when the user gives a talk length ("a 10-minute talk") or asks how many slides they need and gives no exact count. An exact count from the user always wins.

Rule of thumb, not a vendor or Marp rule (no official source exists; checked 2026-11-13):

| Talk length | Slides |
|---|---|
| 5 minutes | 5-8 |
| 10 minutes | 10-15 |
| 20 minutes | 15-25 |

These counts include the title and closing slide. State the number you chose and why, and prefer the low end when the slides carry code or dense figures. Do not pad: a section that needs fewer slides gets fewer.
